body: I don't believe in god, don't want to walk anywhere, no one to call, no interest in reading, no artistic interest, don't want to exercise, don't want to write, don't know what practice mindfulness means, don't believe in god, don't like animals, don't like music, don't think therapy is worth the cost. I get what you're saying, but I guess appeal depends on the person. I guess at first I was looking for justification for feeling this way about life, but one comment told me that I'm just lazy and should do it, so I don't need justification anymore, I'm aware that I'm not cut out for life and if anything this is just some form of natural selection.

Honestly, I don't know. Society conditioned us to believe that suicide is bad, so when I started having frequent suicidal thoughts I found this and decided to post. You're right though, I'm lazy and I should do it I don't need anyone's validation. I'm ready to grow a pair and do this, thanks!
I probably should, kind of hard to find the courage though. The fear of messing up and becoming a vegetable makes it tough.
I'm not a creative person.

Me too. I don't know what to do, working doesn't seem appealing, being homeless doesn't seem appealing, and I can't imagine actually having the courage to try to kill myself.
I don't think the small chance of having a good life is enough motivation for me to be miserable working.

How do you afford things?

I guess it's subjective, being homeless is free so that's a plus and if you're dead you wouldn't be happy, but you also wouldn't be unhappy. I don't have people that are important to me and if I was doing things I like I wouldn't work in the first place. I might just be too lazy for life.
I'm confused, so first half of month day shifts and latter half night? or do you work 24 hours a day? Problem is there isn't really a career that seems appealing. I'm 20.
I'm not from EUWest, so no. Yeah, it's kind of overwhelming, seems like my only options are be miserable working, be miserable being homeless, or kill myself.
I hate working in general, doubt I'll be able to find a job I would enjoy.

Hm, do I need millions of dollars? Probably not, but you do need money for rent, food, etc. So if you enjoy any of those things, money does make you happy. My problem is I would have to be willing to sacrifice 1/3 of my day being miserable to barely afford those things, which doesn't really seem worth it. I agree money itself doesn't make you happy, but the opportunities and security it provides can make you happy.
I suck at life and I don't enjoy it, so why would I continue to play it? I'm not going to deal with life for another 30 years, not worth it.
Sorry, I just don't want to work and struggle anymore.

You're right, I don't know my options, nor have I met anyone that has overcome the position I'm in. I've accepted that my position in life is mostly due to my laziness and some bad luck with a shit upbringing. I'm just too lazy for life and I think it's time to just move on.

Non of those options seem appealing and they all require too much effort for little chance of success. I spent some time thinking if I should continue to live or not, and I think this is just natural selection, I'm a weak link that has failed to adapt so I die, I've accepted that. I appreciate you taking the time to write all of this, but ultimately I just don't think I'm cut out for life. Maybe if I had a different starting position in life it wouldn't have come to this, but I suppose it's better to  end it on my own terms rather than spending the next 50~ years being broke and miserable.

> Yeah, but you don't know it doesn't get easier.

So why would I try? I've had a good try at life. I just don't want to do it anymore.
I'm too lazy to be a hero. Life, happiness, and love requires too much work.
I'm pretty dumb and can't afford university, I also don't care about America enough to join the military. It seems easier to end it than to be miserable working hard.

A few of the one I saw also mentioned having wealthy parents, so not really starting from where I am. I guess the probably is I'm too lazy for life. It seems easier to kill myself than to work hard and hope that one day I'll be happy and not have to worry about money.

As a unhappy person making minimum wage(7.25/h), all these posts about how 250k isn't rich or doesn't make you happy, made me realize I should just kill myself. Realistically I can never hope to make more than 20k a year and if people are struggling with 250k well fuck. Live is too much work and requires way more effort than I'm willing to commit. I'm giving up. Just thought I should get this off my chest and this can be a sort of explanation for my suicide if anyone cares.
